Name: Xtardew - Milfs And Poly And More - Old Events Restoration Project
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This mod aims to restore or rework previously lost content for Pseudodiego's Xtardew Valley mod.

In the transition from 1.5.6 to 1.6, many events were dropped by Pseudodiego. Some due to some incompatability issues with the aim to rework later, some because the content included didn't feel right.

In this mod are files you can add to your mod folders for Xtardew Valley to restore the old content.
~~~
[b]How To Install [/b]

[b]Version 0.0.8 and newer

[/b]There are two folders: [CP]Xtardew Valley Restoration and [CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites.

[CP]Xtardew Valley Restoration can be installed in the normal way.[b] it does not overwrite Xtardew.[/b] Place it alongside your Xtardew folder.

[CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites has 6 files. Take this mod's [CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites folder and copy it into your mod directory. Accept the changes - exactly 3 files in your spritesNonNude folder will be rewritten, your content.json will be rewritten, and you should have 1 new file in your Portraits folder and 1 new file in your SexSprite folder.

[b]Version 0.0.6 and older
[/b]The [CP]Xtardew Valley/content.json in this mod's zip folder replaces and overwrites the file of the same name in your current Mods/[CP]Xtardew Valley mod folder. content_original.json is also there if you ever want to switch back. You can simply copy this mod's [CP]Xtardew Valley folder into your current mod directory

[CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites has 6 files. Take this mod's [CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites folder and copy it into your mod directory. Accept the changes - exactly 3 files in your spritesNonNude folder will be rewritten, your content.json will be rewritten, and you should have 1 new file in your Portrait, SexSprite, and spriteNonNude folders each.
[b]~~~[/b]

[b][size=4]Reworked Events[/size][/b]
